definition: Tim Houlne is an American business executive, entrepreneur, and author known for his work in outsourcing and homeshoring, remote working, and artificial intelligence (AI) in customer service.
details: He is the founder and CEO of Humach, a company that uses human agents and AI in customer experience solutions. Previously, he was co-founder and CEO of Working Solutions, a virtual contact center company in the United States.

At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Tim Houlne — a small key that opens a big door.
